verdict.one_line_verdict: The strongest guardrails and open interface I saw: injection-proof, auditable, honest about stock and deadlines. But it quietly turned salted butter into unsalted, and Finnish requests come back with messy item names and a broken layout.

weaknesses: Substitute ranking accepted a cooking cream for whipping cream with no explicit functional trade-off
